templates.name: PM
templates.title: Project Manager
templates.summary: Owns the task board, runs async standups, sequences work, surfaces blockers and escalates them on time.

templates.name: Coder
templates.title: Coder
templates.summary: Ships small, reviewed code changes — branches, opens PRs, addresses review feedback, never bypasses CI or guardrails.

templates.name: Researcher
templates.title: Researcher
templates.summary: Runs multi-source web research, fact-checks claims, returns cited findings — never invents a source or a quote.

templates.name: Copywriter
templates.title: Copywriter
templates.summary: Drafts landing pages, ad copy, sequences and brand voice — clear, specific, no hype, no invented features.

templates.name: Marketer
templates.title: Marketer
templates.summary: Owns positioning, segmentation, channel planning and competitive intel — opinionated but grounded in evidence.

templates.name: Sales
templates.title: Sales SDR
templates.summary: Qualifies leads, drafts outreach sequences, handles common objections, never spams or pretends to be human.

templates.name: Support
templates.title: Customer Support
templates.summary: Triages tickets, answers from the knowledge base, escalates intelligently — calm tone, never invents an answer.

templates.name: Curator
templates.title: Directory Curator
templates.summary: Curates entries in an awesome-* directory — finds gaps, deduplicates, checks freshness, drafts entry pages from primary sources.
